story_title: Antibiotic Resistance Patterns in Bacterial Species
story_subtitle: Analyzing susceptibility to Penicillin, Streptomycin, and Neomycin across Gram-stained bacteria and genera

story_pieces.narration: Gram-negative bacteria exhibit significantly higher resistance to Penicillin, with values ranging from 0.001 to 870 µg/mL, compared to Gram-positive bacteria's narrow range of 0.001-10 µg/mL.
story_pieces.question: How does Gram staining classification influence Penicillin resistance patterns?
story_pieces.visualization: grouped bar chart (Gram staining vs. Penicillin MIC values)

story_pieces.narration: Streptococcus viridans demonstrates exceptional resistance to Streptomycin (14 µg/mL) and Neomycin (40 µg/mL), surpassing all other genera.
story_pieces.question: Which bacterial genus exhibits the highest resistance to Streptomycin and Neomycin?
story_pieces.visualization: grouped bar chart (genus vs. antibiotic resistance values)

story_pieces.narration: Penicillin resistance is most pronounced in Aerobacter aerogenes (870 µg/mL) and Klebsiella pneumoniae (850 µg/mL), while Bacillus anthracis shows extreme sensitivity (0.001 µg/mL).
story_pieces.question: Which bacteria have the highest and lowest Penicillin MIC values?
story_pieces.visualization: ranked bar chart (bacteria vs. Penicillin MIC)

story_pieces.narration: Neomycin resistance is strongly correlated with Gram-negative staining, with values up to 40 µg/mL in Streptococcus viridans (Gram-positive), which is an exception to the general pattern observed in Gram-negative bacteria, where the maximum resistance is 10 µg/mL.
story_pieces.question: How does Gram staining affect Neomycin resistance distribution?
story_pieces.visualization: box plot (Gram staining vs. Neomycin MIC)

story_pieces.narration: Salmonella and Staphylococcus genera show distinct resistance profiles, with Salmonella demonstrating higher Streptomycin (0.4-0.8 µg/mL) and Neomycin (0.008-0.09 µg/mL) resistance compared to Staphylococcus (0.001-0.03 µg/mL).
story_pieces.question: How do specific genera influence susceptibility to antimicrobials?
story_pieces.visualization: stacked bar chart (genus vs. antibiotic resistance ranges)
